pairs.why: The two chests are almost identical, but B has slightly smoother wood and softer gold, which fits the lesson that the real cards are smooth without being plastic, while A's wood grain and keyhole plate are a bit busier.
Same as q000: B's chest is a little cleaner and softer, while A has slightly more wood-grain texture than the real barrel and chest.
A is built like a real tricorn, with three upturned brims and a full crown, so it has the solid, believable build of the real cards; B is flatter and looks more like a bicorne.
B is the properly built tricorn with upturned brims and a full crown, while A is the flatter, less convincing shape.
The ships match each other, but A's sky has soft clouds like the real boat, bus and coaster cards, while B's empty sky looks plainer.
The ships match each other; B has the soft clouds of the real backgrounds, while A's sky is empty.
